lead.headline: Uniswap governance votes to route v4 fees into UNI burn as Asian exchanges consolidate through regulated M&A
lead.tldr: Token economics are being rewritten at the protocol level while Southeast Asian crypto infrastructure is being assembled through licensed acquisitions, creating two distinct repricing events: UNI's supply dynamics and the scarcity of regulated exchange assets.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: UNI burn poised to grow as Uniswap governance votes on v4 fees and Robinhood Chain expansion
top_signals.summary: Uniswap governance is voting on proposals to route fees from v4 and a potential Robinhood Chain expansion into the UNI token burn system. These measures aim to increase the burn rate of UNI tokens following the 'UNIfication' overhaul.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The UNIfication overhaul is shifting Uniswap from a governance token with theoretical value to a fee-linked asset with programmatic supply reduction, which reprices UNI on cash-flow analogies rather than network-effects multiples.

top_signals.title: French gambling regulator orders ISPs to block Polymarket26m
top_signals.summary: The French gambling regulator has ordered internet service providers to block access to the prediction market platform Polymarket. This move follows regulatory concerns regarding the legality of the platform's betting activities within France.
top_signals.why_it_matters: France's ISP-level blocking of Polymarket signals that prediction markets remain structurally vulnerable to gambling-law reclassification in EU jurisdictions, creating execution risk for any protocol dependent on retail accessibility.

top_signals.title: SBI Holdings completes majority acquisition of Singapore crypto platform Coinhako following MAS approval
top_signals.summary: SBI Holdings has completed the majority acquisition of the Singapore-based cryptocurrency exchange Coinhako. The deal received official approval from the Monetary Authority of Singapore, allowing SBI to integrate the licensed platform into its digital asset ecosystem.
top_signals.why_it_matters: SBI's MAS-approved acquisition of Coinhako demonstrates that regulated exchange licenses in Singapore are now strategic assets worth acquiring at majority-stake premiums, not merely compliance costs.

top_signals.title: Crypto exchange Bybit launches in Indonesia after NOBI acquisition34m
top_signals.summary: Crypto exchange Bybit has officially launched its services in Indonesia following the acquisition of NOBI. This move allows Bybit to establish a legal presence and expand its user base in the Southeast Asian market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Bybit's NOBI acquisition in Indonesia reveals the path for unlicensed exchanges to enter restricted Asian markets: buy local compliance rather than build it, compressing the timeline from years to quarters.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin Japan, which holds no bitcoin, taps EVO Fund in planned $60 million raise to finally buy some
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin Japan is planning a $60 million raise in partnership with EVO Fund to acquire Bitcoin. The company previously invested in AI infrastructure, including SpaceX and Figure AI, rather than digital assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Bitcoin Japan's $60M pivot from AI infrastructure to actual Bitcoin holdings, led by EVO Fund, suggests institutional allocators are now treating BTC exposure as a separate mandate from venture-backed technology bets.

deals.summary: SBI Holdings has completed the majority acquisition of the Singapore-based cryptocurrency exchange Coinhako. The deal received official approval from the Monetary Authority of Singapore, allowing SBI to integrate the licensed platform into its digital asset ecosystem.

Crypto exchange Bybit has officially launched its services in Indonesia following the acquisition of NOBI. This move allows Bybit to establish a legal presence and expand its user base in the Southeast Asian market.

Bitcoin Japan is planning a $60 million raise in partnership with EVO Fund to acquire Bitcoin. The company previously invested in AI infrastructure, including SpaceX and Figure AI, rather than digital assets.

on_the_radar.title: Kaspersky identifies malware framework targeting crypto investors
on_the_radar.summary: Kaspersky has discovered a new malware framework specifically designed to target cryptocurrency investors. The framework employs various techniques to steal digital assets and sensitive information from users' devices.

on_the_radar.title: Bank of America taps new leaders to bridge crypto, AI and traditional finance
on_the_radar.summary: Bank of America has appointed Sonali Theisen as the head of its global digital assets platform and Kevin Milsom as the head of AI transformation. These leadership changes aim to better integrate cryptocurrency, artificial intelligence, and traditional financial services.

on_the_radar.title: Bolivia Eyes USDT as Miners’ AI Pivot Faces New Scrutiny
on_the_radar.summary: Bolivia is considering the recognition of USDT to combat a domestic dollar shortage. Meanwhile, Bitcoin miners are facing increased scrutiny over their pivot toward AI, and CleanSpark has entered a significant $6.6B lease agreement.

on_the_radar.title: Galaxy Digital puts its name on Texas Tech football stadium in 15-year partnership
on_the_radar.summary: Galaxy Digital has entered into a 15-year partnership with Texas Tech University to secure the naming rights for its football stadium. The deal is reportedly valued at over $70 million, marking a significant mainstream branding push for the crypto firm.

on_the_radar.title: Dutch Court Declares Knaken Crypto Platform Bankrupt
on_the_radar.summary: The Dutch crypto platform Knaken has been declared bankrupt by a court. The decision follows investigations by prosecutors into missing customer funds and the blocking of user account access.

on_the_radar.title: ECB’s Cipollone Says Stablecoin Adoption Could Erode Bank Deposits
on_the_radar.summary: ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone warned that the widespread adoption of stablecoins could lead to a decrease in traditional bank deposits. He positioned the digital euro as a necessary alternative to preserve the role of commercial banks in the payments ecosystem.

on_the_radar.title: Coinbase Capitulates on Creator Coins in Base Team Shakeup
on_the_radar.summary: Coinbase is reportedly pivoting away from its 'Creator Coins' initiative following a leadership shakeup within the Base team. This strategic shift comes shortly after the launch of the Robinhood Chain, suggesting a change in competitive focus.

on_the_radar.title: MiCA Licensing Slows as ESMA Adds 14 New CASPs to Its Register
on_the_radar.summary: The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has updated its MiCA register, adding 14 Crypto-Asset Service Providers (CASPs). Notable additions include Ripple Payments Europe and several banking institutions, though the overall pace of licensing is perceived as slowing.

worth_a_read.title: Coinbase Capitulates on Creator Coins in Base Team Shakeup
worth_a_read.note: Coinbase's retreat from creator coins on Base, including team restructuring, offers a real-time case study on how even dominant L2s misjudge consumer crypto primitives and the cost of admitting failure.

worth_a_read.title: Mollie doubles down on Europe with €350m expansion plan: ‘Superapp is a convoluted word’
worth_a_read.note: Mollie's €350M European expansion and explicit rejection of 'superapp' positioning provides a fintech counterpoint to crypto's tendency toward feature bloat and unfocused product ambition.

worth_a_read.title: Charts of the Week: Bitcoin's Great Awakenings
worth_a_read.note: Galaxy's analysis of Bitcoin's 'great awakenings'—periods of dormant supply reactivation—gives a quantified framework for judging whether current on-chain behavior resembles distribution or consolidation phases.

linkedin_post: Three exchange transactions in Asia, none of them organic growth. SBI buys Coinhako for the Singapore license. Bybit buys NOBI for Indonesian access. Bitcoin Japan, which spent years on SpaceX and Figure AI, now needs $60 million from EVO Fund to own actual Bitcoin. The pattern is not expansion. It is admission that the first-mover advantage in unlicensed crypto has expired, and the remaining edge is regulatory plumbing. We underwrite Southeast Asian crypto on license scarcity now, not user growth. Uniswap's v4 fee-to-burn vote is the more interesting repricing event. UNI spent years as a governance token with no governance-adjacent cash flow. The UNIfication overhaul changes the unit economics: if v4 fees route to burn, the token collects a protocol revenue stream that competes with equity in centralized venues. The question is whether the burn rate justifies the current multiple, or whether this is a narrative catch-up to infrastructure that already existed. We are watching the governance vote count. A narrow passage tells one story about insider control. A landslide tells another about validator alignment. Either way, UNI is now an asset we have to model with a DCF, not just a treasuries-and-holdings spreadsheet. The test: does the burn meaningfully outpace emissions, and does Robinhood Chain actually ship.
